run_kmeans_clustering: run k-means clustering on audio feature shards and save the model to disk
run_kmeans_with_subset: run k-means clustering on a sampled subset of audio feature shards
create_km_model: create a MiniBatchKMeans model with configurable clusters, batch size, and tolerance
load_feature_shard: load and optionally sample audio feature frames from a single shard file
load_feature_all_shards: load and concatenate audio features from all shards in a directory
